tools.name: reviso_get_company
tools.description: The connected Reviso agreement: company name, address, VAT number, bank details, base currency, VAT reporting frequency, agreement number and country type, the granting user and the app. Good first call. GET /self.

tools.name: reviso_list_customers
tools.description: List customers with number, name, address, VAT number, currency, payment terms, VAT zone and balance. search matches the name (contains, case-insensitive); filter and sort take the raw Reviso syntax. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /customers.

tools.name: reviso_get_customer
tools.description: One customer by customer number: address, contacts reference, groups, payment terms, VAT zone, credit limit, balance and bank details. GET /customers/{customerNumber}.

tools.name: reviso_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers with number, name, address, VAT number, currency, payment terms and VAT zone. search matches the name (contains). Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /suppliers.

tools.name: reviso_get_supplier
tools.description: One supplier by supplier number: address, group, payment terms, VAT zone, bank account and default voucher template. GET /suppliers/{supplierNumber}.

tools.name: reviso_list_products
tools.description: List products and services with number, name, group, unit, sales price, cost price and (with the inventory module) stock. search matches the name (contains). Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /products.

tools.name: reviso_get_product
tools.description: One product by product number (a string): name, description, group, unit, prices, barcode, stock. GET /products/{productNumber}.

tools.name: reviso_list_invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices by state: drafts (not yet booked), booked (all issued), unpaid, paid, overdue, not-due. Each row has number, customer, date, due date, currency, net/gross/VAT amounts and remaining balance. Filter by customer_number and dates; filter and sort take the raw Reviso syntax. Paged: pa

tools.name: reviso_get_invoice
tools.description: One sales invoice with its lines, recipient, payment terms and totals. A draft is addressed by its draft number (the id of a drafts row), a booked invoice by its bookedInvoiceNumber (the voucher number shown in booked, unpaid, paid, overdue and not-due rows). GET /v2/invoices/drafts/{n} or /v2/invoi

tools.name: reviso_list_orders
tools.description: List sales orders with number, customer, date, currency, net/gross amounts, sent and archived flags. Filter by customer_number; filter and sort take the raw Reviso syntax. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /orders.

tools.name: reviso_get_order
tools.description: One order with its lines, recipient, delivery, payment terms and totals, by its id (the id of a reviso_list_orders row). GET /orders/{id}.

tools.name: reviso_list_quotations
tools.description: List quotations with number, customer, date, currency, net/gross amounts, sent and archived flags. Filter by customer_number; filter and sort take the raw Reviso syntax. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /quotations.

tools.name: reviso_get_quotation
tools.description: One quotation with its lines, recipient, delivery, payment terms and totals, by its id (the id of a reviso_list_quotations row). GET /quotations/{id}.

tools.name: reviso_list_accounts
tools.description: List ledger accounts with number, name, type (heading, profitAndLoss, status, sum, ...), debit/credit side, current balance and barred flag. search matches the name. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /accounts.

tools.name: reviso_list_accounting_years
tools.description: List the agreement's accounting years with their year label, start and end date and closed flag. The year label is what reviso_list_account_totals and reviso_list_entries need. GET /accounting-years.

tools.name: reviso_list_account_totals
tools.description: Total posted per ledger account (in base currency) for one accounting year: a trial balance. Use reviso_list_accounting_years for the year label. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /accounting-years/{year}/totals.

tools.name: reviso_list_entries
tools.description: Ledger entries (postings) of one accounting year: account, date, amount, amount in base currency, currency, entry type (customerInvoice, supplierInvoice, financeVoucher, ...) and voucher number. With account_number only that ledger account's postings are listed. Filter by dates (date_from/date_to);

tools.name: reviso_list_projects
tools.description: List projects (needs the Projects module) with number, name, customer, dates and status. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /project/projects.

tools.name: reviso_list_reference
tools.description: List one lookup table: customer-groups, supplier-groups, product-groups, payment-terms, payment-types, vat-zones, vat-accounts, currencies, units, layouts (invoice layouts), departments, employees, employee-groups, price-groups or country-codes. The numbers in these rows are what the create tools an

tools.name: reviso_create_customer
tools.description: Create a new customer in Reviso. Needs a name, currency and three reference numbers from reviso_list_reference (customer-groups, payment-terms, vat-zones). Not idempotent: calling it twice creates two customers, so search with reviso_list_customers first. Returns the new customer with its customerNu

tools.name: reviso_create_supplier
tools.description: Create a new supplier in Reviso. Needs a name, currency and three reference numbers from reviso_list_reference (supplier-groups, payment-terms, vat-zones). Not idempotent: calling it twice creates two suppliers, so search with reviso_list_suppliers first. Returns the new supplier with its supplierNu

tools.name: reviso_create_product
tools.description: Create a new product or service in Reviso. Needs a product number (your own code, unique), a name and a product group number (reviso_list_reference, resource product-groups). Not idempotent in effect: an existing product number is rejected by Reviso. Returns the new product. POST /products.

tools.name: reviso_create_draft_invoice
tools.description: Create a DRAFT sales invoice for an existing customer. It is not booked and not sent: the user reviews, books and sends it in Reviso. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: reviso_create_customer, reviso_create_supplier · Private data: reviso_get_customer · Public sink: reviso_create_customer, reviso_create_supplier, reviso_create_product, reviso_create_draft_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: reviso_create_customer, reviso_create_supplier · Private data: reviso_get_customer · Public sink: reviso_create_customer, reviso_create_supplier, reviso_create_product, reviso_create_draft_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
